propositions: The eight-phrase _CONTEXT_LEN_HINTS tuple is byte-identical in failure.py and sizing.py, violating DRY and risking silent staleness when one copy is fixed
sizing.is_context_limit_error must remain a def in plan_review/sizing.py because orchestrator.py imports it at module load and tests monkeypatch it by string reference
Importing _CONTEXT_LEN_HINTS from failure.py into sizing.py introduces no cycle since failure.py depends only on rebar.llm.errors and preserves the intended boundary constraint

The eight-phrase list must have exactly one definition under src/rebar with a uniqueness guard that flags re-introduction of duplication and exempts the deliberate third classifier in completion_failures.py:46-79
Five pinning test suites must pass with no assertion edits and demonstrate both positive guard behavior and failure when the duplication is artificially reintroduced
